label: finite-horizon full-field FW action optimization (two initializations)

params.spatial_alignment: one continuous Fourier translation applied only in terminal penalty

formula.action: I=1/2 int_0^T dt int dx a(x,t)^2
formula.objective: J_rho=I + (rho/2)*int dx[(qT-qE_phase)^2+3(uT-uE_phase)^2]; phase of qE chosen from first Fourier moment, not global minimization over shifts

linear.label: Puff–edge linear interpolation
linear.description: control is derived from a prescribed q-reference and forward integration of u; scaled by 0.05 for a stable starting point

reverse.label: Reversed edge unstable branch
reverse.description: control is derived from a prescribed q-reference and forward integration of u; scaled by 0.05 for a stable starting point

comparison.reason: Finite iteration budgets, small endpoint residuals, and no global optimality certificate

warnings: Full gridded space-time control (320 time cells x 160 spatial cells); not Gaussian-restricted.
Both seeds use an admissible PDE control; reference q-shapes alone do not satisfy the unforced u dynamics.
The seed control inferred from q reference is damped by 0.05 for stable optimization.
Finite fixed T=80 with soft endpoint penalty; not an exact heteroclinic instanton or a certified global minimum.
High-penalty L-BFGS runs have not all satisfied strict gradient convergence. Report residuals.
The edge is compared modulo a single spatial translation at final time; no recentering in dynamic simulation.
No mesh or horizon convergence has yet been demonstrated; actions are not directly comparable with prior N=320 Gaussian pulse results.
The terminal phase registration uses first Fourier-moment alignment, not an exhaustive shift minimization.
